text:
maria_cs: FYI — Kyoto Labs hit the APAC edge rate limits during their live demo. They asked for a temporary rate-limit bump + IP allowlist for their demo nodes (52.78.16.0/24). Renewal conversation next quarter, want this to go smoothly. Can ops/infra assist? :wave:
sam_ops: On it. Do we know which APAC region they prefer (tokyo/sydney)?
ivan_net: They asked for Tokyo (ap-northeast-1). Also sent two egress IPs: 52.78.16.12 and 52.78.16.13 — want those whitelisted specifically.
maria_cs: Thanks — copying their note: "demo traffic spike, 300-400 rps sustained, prefer tokyo region. please lift soft limits to 2500 qps for duration."
sam_ops: I'll open an ops task. Proposed: soft qps 2500, hard qps 3500, autorevoke after 72h. Need approval from eng-infra for region pin + allowlist.
ivan_net: For engineering/infra: needs ACL entry on proxy + edge route peering. Minimal checklist: 1) add CIDR 52.78.16.0/24 to tenant allowlist 2) bump soft qps to 2500 for tenant kyoto-labs 3) schedule autorevoke 72h.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: draft change scheduled: 2025-03-26T02:00:00Z — status: pending-approval. Change summary: add CIDR 52.78.16.0/24, tenant soft qps=2500, hard=3500, autorevoke=72h.
julie_am: I'll loop in renewals — flagging this as potential renewal risk if demo fails. tagging @sales-ops for visibility.
sam_ops: Created ENGOPS-4821 and cc'd @eng-infra. Patch notes: "kyoto-labs: ap-northeast-1 allowlist + temp qps bump". Link: https://redwood.internal/ops/ENGOPS-4821
maria_cs: Customer asked for 24h notice before revoke and a short post-demo cost summary. Can someone add a note for finance to prepare token-cost snapshot?
ivan_net: Test curl to validate allowlist once applied:
```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  -H "X-Forwarded-For: 52.78.16.12" 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/healthcheck
```
Expected: 200
sam_ops: I'll run the test after deploy and paste result. For rollback plan: if latency > 500ms or error rate > 2% revert to previous limits and notify CS + customer.
julie_am: Noted. I'll also capture customer feedback post-demo and add to the renewal playbook entry for Kyoto Labs.
maria_cs: Great — thanks all. Please post status updates in this thread, and ping me if approvals block the window. :thumbsup:
